alert.description: Descriptions mix the muted tone with the foreground so they meet AA contrast on tinted alert surfaces.

arc-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and can be hidden on narrow viewports without removing swipe navigation. Single-slide galleries omit arrows and pagination.

carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and showControlsOnMobile hides them below 640px. Single-slide galleries also omit the autoplay button.

code-block.description: The code surface uses a grid by default so newline text nodes no longer add a blank line outside the documentation layout. Numeric syntax tokens also meet AA contrast.

coverflow-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and can be hidden on narrow viewports without removing swipe navigation. Single-slide galleries omit arrows and pagination.

multi-carousel.description: Product cards retain their column width and centre when they fit. Arrows and pagination appear only when the rail has a second reachable page, and the active page resets when the current one disappears.

peek-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and can be hidden on narrow viewports; slideWidth sets a custom card width. Single-slide galleries omit arrows and pagination.

stack-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage and can be hidden on narrow viewports without removing swipe navigation. Single-slide galleries omit arrows and pagination.

thumbnail-carousel.description: Controls center on the visible stage, thumbnails crop to a uniform aspect ratio, and classNames.thumbnailImage targets the actual image. A single image omits arrows and thumbnails.
